units.current_model: Two homogeneous gerund phrases connected by a single nonrepeated coordinating conjunction И are not separated from each other by a comma when they function as homogeneous adverbials of the same predicate. If adjacent gerund phrases belong to different predicates, each phrase is isolated separately according to its own syntactic attachment.

current_model: Such circumstances can be isolated for semantic emphasis or to mark their boundaries.
Isolation is obligatory when the construction interrupts the direct subject-predicate connection.
In other positions isolation is often optional and depends on structure, semantics, order and intended emphasis.
Do not teach a universal comma after an initial prepositional circumstance.
НЕСМОТРЯ НА / НЕВЗИРАЯ НА have their own stronger isolation pattern and should not be mechanically generalized to every derived preposition.

current_model: Restrictive/inclusive/replacement constructions are isolated or not isolated according to context; blanket ALWAYS-ISOLATE wording is rejected.

КРОМЕ constructions are normally treated as isolatable restrictive/inclusive constructions in current academic rules; the old semantic opposition inclusion vs exclusion is not a reliable sole punctuation test.
ВМЕСТО requires a semantic and structural branch: replacement of an action is isolated; replacement of a concrete item may be non-isolated; ВМЕСТО meaning 'за / в качестве' is not isolated.
Absolute initial position and interruption of subject-predicate or governing-dependent connections are strong/mandatory isolation conditions in the academic rule.
